Until 1909, however, there existed no trophy for the event, and then Mr. H. T Blackstaffe, the Olympic Sculling Champion of 1908, and President of our Club in 1909, presented the Shield that bears his name.
This was the nineteenth race for this particular trophy, presented as far back as 1910 by Mr.

Harry Blackstaffe won over a hundred awards for rowing. He was a determined and persistent individual, which was evident in his attempt to win the Diamond Sculls at Henley (this event is a knockout individual contest, open to top international scullers from all over the world).
